hero.title: Build a career with direction
hero.subtitle: Clarity, strategy, and momentum for your next move.
hero.body: From job search to long-term growth, Aptelion helps you understand where you stand, choose the smartest next step, and keep moving with confidence.

proof.guidance: A calm workspace for applications, companies, documents, and decisions.
proof.documents: Signal-guided CV, cover letter, and role-specific document preparation.
proof.practice: Interview practice and follow-up planning tied to real opportunities.

pillars.title: Less noise. More useful next steps.
pillars.subtitle: Aptelion is not a one-time job search tool. It is a structured career workspace for the decisions that shape your next role and the one after it.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.body: See your pipeline, role fit, company context, and risks without switching between scattered notes and spreadsheets.

strategy.title: Strategy

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.body: Know what to do today: follow up, prepare, improve a document, research a company, or move an opportunity forward.

workspace.title: Everything around an opportunity lives in one guided flow.
workspace.body: Aptelion connects the work candidates already do: research, tracking, CV editing, cover letters, interview preparation, and offer thinking. The Signal guidance supports the workflow without turning the product into a noisy chat screen.

pricing.eyebrow: A product people can grow into

session.noPrompt: No prompt yet. Choose a practice scenario to begin.
session.nextEmpty: Choose a scenario and Aptelion will guide the next prompt.

technical.title: Mock technical interview
technical.description: Practice architecture, tradeoffs, and problem solving.
technical.opening: Let's start with a technical scenario. Walk me through how you would design a scalable system for this role.
technical.next: Good. Now explain the main tradeoff you made and what you would monitor in production.

behavioral.title: Behavioral prep
behavioral.description: Shape clear STAR stories for leadership and ambiguity.
behavioral.opening: Tell me about a time you handled a significant conflict within your team.
behavioral.next: Now tighten the answer into a clear situation, action, result, and lesson.

salary.title: Salary negotiation
salary.description: Practice compensation conversations without leaving this workspace.
salary.opening: Let's practice the opening of a compensation conversation. State your target calmly and anchor it with evidence.
salary.next: Now respond to pushback without lowering your position too quickly.

mock.voiceAnswer: I would start by clarifying the requirements, then propose a design with clear tradeoffs and failure modes.
mock.followUp: Good. Make the answer more specific: name the constraint, explain your decision, and finish with the measurable outcome.

upload.title: Upload offer letter
upload.body: Start a simulated V1 analysis to structure compensation, risks, and response strategy. No legal advice is provided.

snapshot.title: Offer snapshot
snapshot.body: Review the compensation structure, risk items, and response angle before drafting your reply.

checklist.title: Review before reply
checklist.base: Base salary matches your minimum target.
checklist.equity: Equity schedule and strike details are clear.
checklist.restrictions: Restrictions and notice period are understood.

playbook.title: Negotiation playbook
playbook.body: Use these calmer response angles to prepare a clear, evidence-led reply.

valueAlignment.title: Value alignment
valueAlignment.script: I am excited about the role. Based on the scope we discussed and the impact I can bring, I would like to align the base closer to the upper range.
valueAlignment.impact: Best when the match is strong and you want to keep the tone constructive.

marketEvidence.title: Market evidence
marketEvidence.script: For roles with this scope and skill mix, I am seeing stronger base ranges. A revised base would make this much easier to accept quickly.
marketEvidence.impact: Best when you have comparable data or competing process momentum.

riskClarification.title: Risk clarification
riskClarification.script: Before I can make a final decision, I would like to clarify the bonus conditions, equity terms, and restrictions in writing.
riskClarification.impact: Best when the offer has unclear terms or legal/compensation risk.
